_comment: Synthetic vulnerability knowledge base for this project. Modeled on the shape of real advisories (plugin name, affected version range, CVE-style id, false-positive notes) but IDs and details are invented for the hackathon and NOT real CVEs. Public/synthetic data only, per ground rule 07.

entries.false_positive_notes: Banner strings are sometimes left unchanged by distro maintainers after backporting a patch. Always check patch level, not just banner version.
Extremely narrow affected range (single point release). Very commonly misreported against nearby versions.
Some scanners flag TLS 1.0/1.1 support even when TLS 1.2+ is also offered and preferred; check whether the weak protocol is actually negotiable, not just listed.
Version-independent (a config issue, not a version bug). Requires direct evidence of a working login, not just an open port.
Single specific compromised release. Any other version is not affected regardless of banner similarity.
Config issue, not version-dependent. Needs evidence auth is actually disabled, not just that Redis is present.
